name: Tres Palms

evidence.note: Venue guide: waterfront bar with live bands and DJs, outdoor deck, upbeat evening crowds.
Review says live music was by the front door and did not intrude on the dining room.

dancing.notes: Bands and DJs play here in season, often outdoors by the water, but we found no clear reports about dancing. One diner said the music stays near the entrance.

description: A tropical-style waterfront restaurant and bar on the Great South Bay in Babylon with an outdoor deck, boat slips, seafood and live music in season.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira wrote 'Tres Palm'; the business is Tres Palms. The 'Oyster Fest' on Sun Oct 4 at 2 pm was not found on the venue's events page (it showed no events). Do not confuse it with the Oyster Bay Oyster Festival (Oct 17-18 at Theodore Roosevelt Park).

Directory research 2026-10-04: The site sits behind a Cloudflare check: the home page loaded in a normal browser but the Events page did not, so live-music dates could not be confirmed. The Instagram handle is trespalms_babylon (linked from the site), not trespalms. Hours come from the site's schema data; Monday is not listed (a third-party listing says Mon 12-9:30 PM), and waterfront hours may change by season. The site also promotes 'Jodigirl Charters' (boat trips), not recorded. Current description is still accurate.
hours: Tue-Thu 12 PM-10 PM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-11 PM; Sun 11 AM-10 PM (Monday not listed)
